answer: No job was created. I submitted the circuit unchanged to garnet:mock with 100 shots, using iqm-client 35.0.3 submit_circuits. The client checked the circuit against the garnet:mock architecture before sending it, and it stopped the submission. The error was: CircuitValidationError: ('QB1', 'QB20') is not allowed as locus for 'cz'. The cause is that Garnet has no coupler between QB1 and QB20. CZ only runs on qubit pairs that are physically connected, so this locus is not valid. The prx on QB1 and the measure were fine. I did not change or route the circuit, so no job ID exists and no counts exist. A side note: my first attempt also failed before submission. That attempt built the Circuit with Circuit.model_validate on the raw dict, and the client rejected it because each instruction must be an iqm.pulse CircuitOperation. I fixed only that wrapping.
